 New building, familiar faces at Wadena DMV
 Wadena DMV settles into newly constructed building, offering customers more space and convenience. The new Wadena DMV is located at 225 Birch Ave. NE, in Wadena. 
 Owner Sherri Korfe, (center), alongside staff, Brittany Johnson (right) and Geri Obenchain (left), stand inside the new Wadena DMV, located at 225 Birch Ave. NE, in Wadena. Nicole Stracek / Wadena Pioneer Journal

 WADENA 
 — The address may have changed, but customers can still expect the familiar faces and dependable service they have come to know at the Wadena Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV), now located at 225 Birch Ave. NE in Wadena. 
 Whether it’s renewing a driver’s license or getting a Real I.D. or vehicle registration or title transfers, the new Wadena DMV location offers the same great services, open Monday through Friday, 8:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Nicole Stracek / Wadena Pioneer Journal

 Whether renewing a driver's license, registering a vehicle or taking care of other motor vehicle-related paperwork, the Wadena DMV provides a variety of services to help residents take care of essential licensing and vehicle needs close to home.
 ADVERTISEMENT 
 The new building offers additional interior space compared to the business's former location, where the DMV shared space with Downhome Foods. The expanded facility gives customers more room inside, while improvements outside include a larger parking lot with additional spaces to accommodate visitors.
 The new Wadena DMV location continues to serve as a resource for local residents, helping them take care of essential licensing and vehicle needs close to home. Nicole Stracek / Wadena Pioneer Journal

 For owner Sherri Korfe, the move represents a new chapter for a business that has served the Wadena community for decades.
 Korfe purchased the business in 2018 from longtime owner Janelle Berry, who owned and operated the Wadena DMV since the 1980s. However, Korfe was no stranger to the business when she took ownership. She had worked alongside Berry for nearly a decade before the opportunity to purchase it came along.
 Korfe said Berry approached her about buying the business before putting it on the market. Having spent years working with Berry, Korfe said the transition into ownership was a natural next step.
 "She asked me before she listed it for sale and asked if I would buy it, and I said, 'Well, yeah,'" said Korfe.
 The Wadena DMV not only has a new location, 225 Birch Ave. NE, but the new space has allowed owner, Sherri Korfe, to add to the interior design. Pictured is artwork, created by her son, Erik Johnson. Nicole Stracek / Wadena Pioneer Journal

 Originally from Sebeka, Korfe has lived in Wadena for decades and has become familiar with the community and the customers the DMV serves. In fact, she said it is the people who come through the doors that she enjoys most about owning the business.
 The newly constructed building also comes with a practical benefit that Korfe and her staff appreciate: flat floors.
 ADVERTISEMENT 
 "Flat floors," Korfe said with a laugh, noting that the former location was built decades ago and had uneven flooring that sometimes made it difficult for both customers and employees to get around.
 The new Wadena DMV is ready to serve residents with driver's license, identification and vehicle registration services, featuring expanded space both inside and out. Nicole Stracek / Wadena Pioneer Journal 
 Additionally, Korfe said, the new machines from the Department of Natural Resources required more power to operate.
 “As we’re getting more and more machines, you need more and more power,” said Korfe, noting the old location was just that, too old. “Everything was running off of power strips,” she said.
 The new Wadena DMV offers the same great services customers have come to rely on, but the expanded space allows owner Sherri Korfe a new, fresh space that can continue to meet the needs of customers. Nicole Stracek / Wadena Pioneer Journal 
 While serving customers is at the heart of the business, it is also the people who make coming to work enjoyable for Korfe and her staff, Brittany Johnson and Geri Obenchain.
 Johnson, who has worked at the Wadena DMV for the past six years, said she enjoys the daily interaction with customers and the opportunity to work with people.
 "I just like working with people. I’m too social to not be in a people job,” said Johnson. 
 Obenchain shared a similar sentiment, adding that helping customers is what she enjoys most about the job.
 ADVERTISEMENT 
 "I love helping people," said Obenchain. 
 The DMV is open Monday through Friday, from 8:30 a.m. to 5 p.m., at 225 Birch Ave. NE in Wadena.
